fundamentals.summary: UNISEM’s revenue is recovering, but earnings quality and valuation remain unfavorable: the supplied snapshot has a 106.75x trailing P/E, 4.2% operating margin, and negative RM164.451m free cash flow, while the latest 1H2026 filing reports a RM3.445m net loss. Q2 revenue grew about 20.0% year over year and Q2 profit was RM9.910m, but this has not yet translated into sustained half-year profitability or cash generation. The fundamental signal is sell at medium confidence, with a recovery case dependent on material margin and cash-flow improvement.
